item.title: HIQA says action required at Kerry nursing home to ensure staffing meets residents needs
item.description: The health watchdog says action is required to ensure staffing at a North Kerry nursing home was appropriate the meet residents needs. The Health and Quality Authority carried out an unannounced inspection at Lystoll Lodge, Skehenerin, Listowel in August. The facility was inspected across 23 areas of the Health Act 2007. item.title: Leeds and Man Utd draw
item.description: Leeds and Manchester United have drawn 1-all at Elland Road in the Premier League. The point takes the visitors up to fifth - for a short time at least - while their opponents move further clear of the relegation zone. Manchester City take on managerless Chelsea later knowing victory will see them climb back up to second. item.title: Road reopened following fatal Headford crash
item.description: The road has been reopened following a fatal collision in Headford. Gardaí and emergency services attended the scene on the L3013 at Knockdooragh, Headford last night. The collision involved a single vehicle that collided with a tree and occurred at approximately 11.20. Advertisement The driver of the car, a man aged in his 30s, was pronounced deceased at the scene. Gardaí are appealing to anyone who may have witnessed this collision to contact them. item.title: KCC urges road users to travel with caution amid status yellow ice warning
item.description: Kerry County Council is advising all road users to travel with extra care tonight due to freezing temperatures and warnings from Met Éireann. A yellow weather warning for icy conditions is in place for the county from now until to 11 o'clock tomorrow morning. Council crews will be treating priority routes twice overnight tonight in line with the Council’s Winter Maintenance Plan. item.title: Final call for entries to Specsavers Short Story Competition
item.description: Specsavers Kerry is issuing a final call for young storytellers to enter their short story competition. The initiative celebrates Specsaver’s sponsorship of the Junior and Senior Children's Book of the Year categories at the An Post Irish Book Awards. Winners will receive a collection of all titles shortlisted in the category and €500 for their school library. Advertisement To enter, children can submit a short story no longer than 500 words. item.description: St Brigid's of Roscommon will play Dingle in this year's All Ireland Senior Football Championship decider. item.title: Fulham and Liverpool draw
item.description: There was a dramatic end at Craven Cottage where Fulham and Liverpool played out a 2-all draw in the Premier League. The visitors thought they'd won it in the 94th minute - only for Harrison Reed to score a wonder goal for Fulham 3 minutes later. Manchester United were held to a 1-all draw away at Leeds, and that was also the score between Tottenham and Sunderland. Advertisement Brentford were 4-2 winners at Everton, while Newcastle sealed a 2-nil victory at home to Crystal Palace.
